answer: An identity locks a 50 bond and publishes work as a graph vertex. Activation needs three users who reused it, each staking 10 credits for a pigment tag on the vertex in the dawn ledger, one tag per identity per epoch. The dawn auditors void both on a duplicate pigment tag or a consumer backing two vertices, burning both bonds. Each fake needs three consumers: 95 credits (50 locked, 45 recruitment); 1,000 fakes cost 95,000 and need 3,000 consumers, no merging. A rented-consumer ring fails, since a stamp without a use record burns the bond. An honest worker pays one 50 bond, refundable.
